methodology: Development-only regressions from a seeded 522-work expansion. Reviewed fill colors use maximum-channel RGB tolerance 25; restoration refusal labels protect visible grid/tone art. Silver OCR rectangles, not gold text masks. No held-out confirmation crops are included. Raw RGBA uses zlib/base64 with SHA256 provenance.
